description: Fetches one immutable evidence attachment by the id returned from get_review_evidence. Binary bytes are returned as an MCP embedded resource, never injected into text. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.
name: get_review_evidence_attachment
